title: KiasuParents
line: Singapore's online community and resource hub for parents.
problem: KiasuParents is a widely-used online community and resource hub for parents in Singapore, with lots of articles and busy forums. It needed new features and pages without slowing the website down.
did: I worked on enhancing the platform through new feature development, bug fixes and continuous content updates based on the client's requirements. My contributions included implementing new webpages, improving application performance and maintaining stability across key modules.
outcome: New features for thousands of parents, on a faster and more stable website.

story.title: The Challenge
story.body: KiasuParents is a widely-used online community and resource hub for parents in Singapore, with lots of articles and very active forums. The website needed new pages and features without slowing it down for its users.

story.title: What I Did
story.body: As part of the Amber Creative team, I implemented new webpages, improved the application's performance and fixed bugs across its key modules. I also handled continuous content updates guided by the client's requirements, and gained experience with managing content workflows, administrative tasks and backend operations.

story.title: The Tools
story.body: The website brings several systems together: Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, alongside WordPress, Strapi CMS, Mautic and NodeBB.

story.title: The Result
story.body: New features for thousands of parents in Singapore, on a faster and more stable website.
